en: Vintage black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town in a valley surrounded by rolling hills and fields. Compact, multi‑story houses with steep roofs fill the foreground, with factory chimneys visible among them. In the distance stands a tall church with a prominent spire. At the bottom, there is a blank white area typical for message space on old postcards, with printed captions in red and small publisher information.
